subject: Request: strategic bundle deviation + onboarding waiver (Medivance)
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia@medivance.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medivance.com
Date: 2028-07-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Strategic bundle ask after pilot call — term sheet attached

Hi Neha / Grace,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the product fit looks strong and our technical team liked the KV caching approach. I attached an updated term sheet with the commercial ask from our side. High level:
- 24-month pilot, committed spend floor $120k/year
- Requesting 40% first-year discount on hosted API usage (tiered down in year 2)
- Waive onboarding professional services fee ($25k) and provide a single technical success day free of charge

We understand this pushes past standard guardrails but Medivance is willing to commit to the 24-month term and be a marquee healthcare reference for your VPC play. Can you confirm whether this is possible or what approvals we should route to?

Attachments: Medivance_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf

Best,
Alicia Moreno
Head of Strategic Procurement
Medivance Health
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@medivance.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Strategic bundle ask after pilot call — term sheet attached

Alicia — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the term sheet. Appreciate Medivance's willingness to be a reference — that helps a lot.

Quick notes from our side:
- We can accept a 24-month pilot commitment, but a 40% first-year usage discount exceeds our standard commercial threshold for hosted customers (our limit for auto-approval is 25%).
- Waiving the onboarding PS fee is feasible on a case-by-case basis if the commitment and reference are strong, but that will need senior approval.

Im looping in Priyom and Grace internally to prepare a short exception memo for exec review. Can you confirm whether the $120k/year floor is annualized consumption (tokens) or billed subscription + usage? Also, if you can flag any regulatory/PHI constraints we should be aware of for the VPC/on-prem path, that will speed the security review.

Ill share an internal packet this afternoon for a VP/CFO exception request.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Medivance — exception packet for >30% discount + onboarding waiver (DEAL-8241)

Team — drafting the authorization memo for a commercial exception. Key facts:
- Account: Medivance Health (large regional health system; HIPAA scope)
- Ask: 40% off first-year hosted API usage; waive $25k onboarding PS fee; 24-month committed pilot with $120k/year floor
- Rationale: strategic healthcare reference for our VPC offering + potential Dedicated conversion in Q2 next year; procurement has signaled enterprise references/press interest
- Financial impact: attached cost model shows ~35% gross margin erosion in year 1 at the proposed pricing (medivance_cost_model_Q3.xlsx) — offset estimated by reference value and expected Dedicated upsell probability (~30% over 12–18 months).

Proposed approval path:
1) VP commercial (Priyom) endorsement
2) CFO signoff required for discount >30% and onboarding fee waiver (Markus)
3) Legal to finalize amendment and DocuSign

Requesting: Priyom — please review and add a short business case paragraph (max 3 bullets). Grace — can you confirm readiness of security intake and any required SOC/SLA commitments? Ill attach the draft term sheet and send to Markus once we have your inputs.

Attachments: medivance_cost_model_Q3.xlsx

-Neha
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-31T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: INTERNAL: Medivance — exception packet for >30% discount + onboarding waiver (DEAL-8241)

Markus — forwarding a short packet for CFO review. TL;DR: Medivance requests a deeper first-year discount (40%) and onboarding waiver in exchange for a 24-month commitment and being a named healthcare reference for our VPC solution. We estimate the reference + potential Dedicated conversion could drive $450k incremental ARR over 18 months (base case).

Why I support:
- Strategic signal in healthcare vertical (public case studies + joint webinars)
- High probability of Dedicated conversion given Medivance's traffic profile and compliance needs
- Procurement is willing to accelerate signature if onboarding fee is waived and pricing is agreeable

If youre supportive, approve with conditions: 1) cap the first-year discount at 35% instead of 40%; 2) require a performance clause (baseline usage floor and midpoint check at month 9) and 3) legal to include a make-good clause if reference is not delivered.

—Priyom
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-01T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: INTERNAL: Medivance — exception packet for >30% discount + onboarding waiver (DEAL-8241)

Team — after reviewing the packet and the projected upsell math, I approve a conditional exception with the following firm conditions:
1) First-year discount capped at 35% (not to exceed).
2) Onboarding PS fee waived if Medivance signs the 24-month commitment and completes the technical reference checklist within 90 days of launch.
3) Legal to add a performance / make-good clause: if reference commitments are not met by month 12, Medivance pays a retroactive fee equivalent to the waived onboarding ($25k) plus a 10% revenue clawback on year 1 discount differential.
4) All concessions to be documented in an amendment and routed through DocuSign.

Neha — you can communicate the approval and the attached conditions back to Alicia. Priyom/Grace — please coordinate on the amendment language and security addendum. Im copying Legal separately in the DocuSign thread (will follow).

Markus Klein
CFO, Redwood Inference

--- End of thread ---
